guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the planning fee share, the smallest fee, the markup, the target margin, the reserve and the owner approval limit.
Check Events: contract value, planned, agreed and actual cost, guests and status. The margin, the cost per guest and the plan check fill in by themselves.
Enter or check every category on Budget Lines. The variance to plan, the cost per guest and the over plan flag fill in.
Keep Category Share Guide, Per-guest Cost Guide, Guest Count Bands and Markup by Category current: they answer how much a new event should cost.
Use Catering Menus, Venue Pricing, Vendor Price List and Extras Price List to price a proposal, and Season Price Index to see how the month moves the price.
Record every quote on Quote Comparison and mark the one chosen. The saving against the highest quote and the rank fill in.
Record every change after signing on Budget Changes and every saved version on Budget Versions. Changes above your limit are flagged for the owner.
Write each use of the reserve on Contingency Use and each change of the head count on Guest Count Changes. The reserve left and the lock check fill in.
Log team hours on Event Hours, keep Labour Allowance and Planning Fee Schedule up to date and read the fee per hour on Events.
Enter every tasting on Tasting Costs: the costs you did not bill to the client are flagged.

Use the 14 calculators before you quote: budget by guest count, catering, venues, guest changes, markup, price per guest, staff, rentals, bar, overrun, reserve, fee yield, two quotes and a what-if grid.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages).
Read Event Budget Dashboard and Charts every week: margin, overruns, reserve used, guest count changes, labour hours and savings from quotes.

listing.title: Wedding and Event Planner Budget Excel Template: Budget by Guest Count, Quote Comparison, Contingency, Margin per Event
listing.headline: Know what an event will cost and earn before the day
listing.description:
Cost every wedding and event from the guest count in one Excel workbook. Budget Lines holds the budget, the planned, agreed and actual cost of every category, and the variance to plan, the cost per guest and the over budget flag fill in by themselves. Events shows the planned and actual margin, the margin share, the cost per guest and the planning fee per labour hour.

Category Share Guide, Per-guest Cost Guide, Guest Count Bands and Markup by Category tell you what a new event should cost at 60, 114 or 250 guests. Catering Menus, Venue Pricing with the minimum spend rule, Vendor Price List and Extras Price List price a proposal, and Season Price Index shows how the month moves the price.

Quote Comparison keeps every quote with the one chosen and the saving against the highest. Budget Changes and Budget Versions record what the client approved after signing, Contingency Use shows what the reserve paid for and what is left, Guest Count Changes shows the cost of every head count change and whether the count locked on time, and Tasting Costs flags the costs you did not bill.

14 calculators cover the budget by guest count, catering and bar, venue costs, guest count changes, markup and margin, price per guest, service staff, rental quantities, bar quantities, the overrun forecast, reserve size, fee yield, two quotes and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part three of the Wedding and event planner suite. A standard Excel workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Money is shown in one plain currency. It helps you plan and does not promise results.

zh.Open Start and type your company name an: 打开“开始”，然后在黄色单元格中输入您的公司名称和您自己的限制：规划费用份额、最低费用、加价、目标利润、储备金和所有者批准限制。
zh.Check Events: contract value, planned, a: 检查活动：合同价值、计划、商定和实际成本、宾客和状态。保证金、每位客人的费用和计划支票自行填写。
zh.Enter or check every category on Budget: 输入或检查 预算线 上的每个类别。填写计划差异、每位客人的费用和超额计划标志。
zh.Keep Category Share Guide, Per-guest Cos: 保持 分类分享指南、每位客人的费用指南、宾客人数范围 和 按类别标记 最新：它们回答新活动的费用。
zh.Use Catering Menus, Venue Pricing, Vendo: 使用 餐饮菜单、场地定价、供应商价目表 和 附加价格表 为提案定价，并使用 季节价格指数 查看当月价格变化情况。
zh.Record every quote on Quote Comparison a: 记录 报价对比 上的每一条引言并标记所选的引言。填写最高报价和排名的节省。
zh.Record every change after signing on Bud: 记录登录 预算变化 后的每项更改以及 预算版本 上的每个保存的版本。超出限制的更改会标记给所有者。
zh.Write each use of the reserve on Conting: 在 应急使用 上记录每次预订的使用情况，并在 宾客数量变化 上记录每次更改客人计数。留下保留并填写锁定检查。
zh.Log team hours on Event Hours, keep Labo: 在 活动时间 上记录团队工作时间，使 劳动津贴 和 规划费用表 保持最新状态，并查看活动的每小时费用。
zh.Enter every tasting on Tasting Costs: th: 输入 品尝费用 上的每次品尝：标记出您未向客户收取的费用。
zh.Use the 14 calculators before you quote:: 在报价前使用 14 个计算器：按客人数量、餐饮、场地、客人变化、加价、每位客人的价格、员工、租金、酒吧、超支、保留、费用收益、两个报价和假设网格划分的预算。
zh.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: 打印 10 张纸和 10 个文档，遵循 10 个清单，然后点击消息链接以打开与已写文本的聊天（28 条消息）。
zh.Read Event Budget Dashboard and Charts e: 每周阅读 活动预算仪表板 和图表：利润、超支、已用储备、客人数量变化、工时和报价节省。
zh.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: 本工作簿的所有下拉选项。修改此处的选项，所有工作表都会同步更新。
zh.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: 数据随工作表自动更新。更改年份即可查看往年数据。
zh.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: 在黄色单元格中选择，其余内容将自动填写。可直接打印。
zh.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: 在此编辑消息内容；大括号中的字段会自动从每行资料填入。相关链接位于各个表格中。
zh.Choose a record: each step gets its due: 选择一条记录：每个步骤都会生成到期日期。每条记录请复制一份此工作表。
zh.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: 工作表实时图表。在黄色单元格中选择后，所有图表和仪表图都会自动更新。

ru.This quote: {col:quotes.vendor}, {col:qu: Эта цитата: {col:quotes.vendor}, {col:quotes.quoted}, рейтинг {col:quotes.rank} по цене. Самая низкая цена — {col:quotes.best_price}, самая высокая — {col:quotes.highest}. Выбрано: {col:quotes.chosen}. Примечания: {col:quotes.notes}.
ru.Please confirm which quote you prefer. T: Пожалуйста, подтвердите, какое предложение вы предпочитаете. Сохранение выбранной котировки против самой высокой равно {col:quotes.saving}.
ru.Price per guest {col:menus.price_pg}, ba: Цена за гостя {col:menus.price_pg}, бар за гостя {col:menus.bar_pg}, вместе {col:menus.all_in}. Минимум {col:menus.min_guests} гостей. Для 100 гостей общая сумма составит {col:menus.total_100}.
ru.Please tell us your food allergy list an: Пожалуйста, сообщите нам свой список пищевой аллергии и любые другие требования по крайней мере за 21 день до мероприятия, чтобы поставщик общественного питания мог спланировать его.
ru.Venue cost summary of {set:company}, dat: Сводная информация о стоимости проведения мероприятия {set:company} от {today}.
ru.Venue: {col:venues.name}, {col:venues.ar: Место проведения: {col:venues.name}, {col:venues.area}, {col:venues.kind}, места {col:venues.seated}. Комендантский час {col:venues.curfew}, {col:venues.setup_hours} часов на прибытие и сборку.
ru.Hire fee {col:venues.hire_fee}. Minimum: Плата за аренду {col:venues.hire_fee}. Минимальные расходы {col:venues.min_spend}. Дополнительный час {col:venues.extra_hour}. Для 100 гостей стоимость составляет {col:venues.cost_100}, то есть {col:venues.cost_pg} на гостя.
ru.The minimum spend counts food and drink: Минимальные расходы учитывают только еду и напитки. Пожалуйста, сравните это место с другими вариантами на том же листе.
ru.Used on {col:cont.date}: {col:cont.used}: Используется на {col:cont.date}: {col:cont.used} для {col:cont.what_for}. На данный момент используется для мероприятия: {col:cont.used_total}. После этого использования остается резерв: {col:cont.left_now}. Резервный чек: {col:cont.state}.
ru.Any reserve that is not used is not bill: Любой неиспользованный резерв не выставляется счет клиенту.
ru.Event profit summary for the owner: Сводная информация о прибыли от мероприятия для владельца
ru.Event profit summary of {set:company}, d: Сводная информация о прибыли от мероприятия {set:company} от {today}.
ru.Revenue {col:events.revenue}. Cost {col:: Доход {col:events.revenue}. Стоимость {col:events.cost_now}. Наценка до оплаты труда {col:events.actual_margin}, которая равна {col:events.margin_share}. Проверка маржи: {col:events.target_flag}.
ru.Hours logged {col:events.labour_hours},: Записано часов {col:events.labour_hours}, стоимость рабочей силы {col:events.labour_cost}, почасовая плата за планирование {col:events.fee_per_hour}. План проверки: {col:events.plan_flag}.
ru.Event {col:gc.event_id}. Guests at signi: Событие {col:gc.event_id}. Гости при подписании: {col:gc.guests_signing}. Гости сейчас: {col:gc.guests_now}, изменение {col:gc.change}.
ru.The cost impact of the change is {col:gc: Влияние изменения на стоимость составляет {col:gc.cost_impact}. Счетчик гостей фиксируется на {col:gc.lock_due}; после этого дня мы заказываем еду, напитки и аренду на заблокированный номер.
Пожалуйста, подпишитесь, чтобы подтвердить количество гостей. Проверка блокировки: {col:gc.lock_state}.
ru.Choose the tier and the per-guest budget: Выберите уровень и бюджет на гостя.
ru.Split the budget with the category share: Разделите бюджет с помощью руководства по доле категорий
ru.Add the planning fee and the reserve: Добавьте плату за планирование и резерв
ru.Ask at least three vendors for a quote: Обратитесь за ценой как минимум к трем поставщикам
ru.Check what each quote includes: Проверьте, что включает в себя каждое предложение
ru.Add travel, set-up and overtime: Добавьте поездки, настройку и сверхурочную работу
ru.Send the guest count reminder to the cli: Отправьте клиенту напоминание о количестве гостей
ru.Tell the client what the reserve paid fo: Расскажите клиенту, за что оплачен резерв
ru.Enter the actual cost on every budget li: Введите фактическую стоимость в каждую строку бюджета.
ru.Check the overruns and who approved them: Проверьте перерасходы и кто их утвердил
ru.Confirm the time with the client and the: Согласуйте время с клиентом и продавцом
ru.Bill the tasting if it is billable: Выставьте счет за дегустацию, если она подлежит оплате
ru.List the prices that expire: Перечислите цены, срок действия которых истекает
ru.Ask each vendor for the new price list: Спросите у каждого продавца новый прайс-лист
ru.Events within their cost plan: Мероприятия в рамках своего стоимостного плана
ru.Events with a fee yield on target: События с комиссионной доходностью на целевом уровне
ru.Cost per guest per event type: Стоимость за гостя за тип мероприятия
ru.Contract value per month of the event: Стоимость контракта за месяц проведения мероприятия
ru.Budget moved by changes per month: Бюджет перемещается с изменениями в месяц
ru.Guest count change per event type: Изменение числа гостей по типу мероприятия
ru.Planning fee per hour per event type: Плата за планирование за час за тип мероприятия
ru.Open Start and type your company name an: Откройте «Пуск» и введите название своей компании и свои собственные лимиты в желтых ячейках: долю платы за планирование, наименьшую комиссию, наценку, целевую маржу, резерв и лимит одобрения владельца.
ru.Check Events: contract value, planned, a: Проверьте события: стоимость контракта, запланированную, согласованную и фактическую стоимость, гостей и статус. Наценка, стоимость за гостя и плановый чек заполняются сами собой.
ru.Enter or check every category on Budget: Введите или отметьте каждую категорию на Строки бюджета. Отклонение от плана, стоимость за гостя и флаг превышения плана заполняются.
ru.Keep Category Share Guide, Per-guest Cos: Следите за актуальностью Руководство по обмену категориями, Руководство по стоимости на гостя, Группы подсчета гостей и Разметка по категориям: они отвечают, сколько должно стоить новое мероприятие.
ru.Use Catering Menus, Venue Pricing, Vendo: Используйте Меню кейтеринга, Цены на место проведения, Прайс-лист продавца и Прайс-лист дополнительных услуг, чтобы оценить предложение, и Сезонный индекс цен, чтобы увидеть, как цена меняется в течение месяца.
ru.Record every quote on Quote Comparison a: Запишите каждую цитату по Сравнение котировок и отметьте выбранную. Экономия по самой высокой котировке и заполнению рейтинга.
ru.Record every change after signing on Bud: Записывайте каждое изменение после входа в Изменения бюджета и каждую сохраненную версию в Бюджетные версии. Изменения, превышающие установленный лимит, помечаются для владельца.
ru.Write each use of the reserve on Conting: Записывайте каждое использование резерва в Использование в непредвиденных обстоятельствах и каждое изменение количества гостей в Изменение количества гостей. Остался резерв и заполняется проверка замка.
ru.Log team hours on Event Hours, keep Labo: Регистрируйте рабочее время команды на Часы проведения мероприятий, держите Трудовое пособие и График оплаты за планирование в курсе событий и читайте почасовую оплату на мероприятиях.
ru.Enter every tasting on Tasting Costs: th: Введите каждую дегустацию в Стоимость дегустации: отмечаются расходы, которые вы не выставили клиенту.
ru.Use the 14 calculators before you quote:: Прежде чем выставлять расценки, воспользуйтесь 14 калькуляторами: бюджет по количеству гостей, кейтерингу, местам проведения, смене гостей, наценке, цене за гостя, персоналу, аренде, бару, перерасходу средств, резерву, доходу от сборов, двум расценкам и сетке «что, если».
ru.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Распечатайте 10 листов и 10 документов, следуйте 10 контрольным спискам и коснитесь ссылки на сообщение, чтобы открыть чат с уже написанным текстом (28 сообщений).
ru.Read Event Budget Dashboard and Charts e: Каждую неделю читайте Панель управления бюджетом мероприятия и графики: маржа, перерасход средств, использованный резерв, изменения количества гостей, рабочее время и экономия от котировок.
ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.
ru.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Данные обновляются по вашим листам. Измените год, чтобы посмотреть прошлые периоды.
ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.
ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.
ru.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Актуальные диаграммы по данным ваших листов. Выберите значения в жёлтых ячейках — диаграммы и индикаторы обновятся автоматически.

tr.Know what an event will cost and earn be: Bir etkinliğin ne kadara mal olacağını ve kazandıracağını günden önce öğrenin
tr.Event budgets by guest count, quotes, re: Konuk sayısına göre etkinlik bütçeleri, teklifler ve marj
tr.Budget by guest count and tier: Konuk sayısı ve pakete göre bütçe
tr.type the guests and the budget per guest: Misafirleri ve misafir başına bütçeyi yazın; her kategori tutarını planlama ücreti ve sözleşme bedeliyle birlikte kendi kategori paylaşımlarınızdan alır.
tr.every event and category shows budget, p: her etkinlik ve kategori bütçeyi, planlanan, mutabakata varılan ve fiili maliyeti, sapmayla birlikte, misafir başına maliyeti ve plan aşımı işaretini gösterir
tr.Event margin and cost per guest: Etkinlik marjı ve konuk başına maliyet
tr.planned and actual margin, margin share,: Her etkinlik için planlanan ve gerçekleşen marj, marj oranı, konuk başına maliyet ve işçilik saati başına ücret; hedef marjın altındakiler işaretlenir
tr.every quote for a category side by side: Bir kategori için her teklif, seçtiğiniz teklifin en yüksek, en düşük, sıralaması ve kaydıyla yan yana
tr.Guest count change and lock date: Konuk sayısı değişikliği ve kilit tarihi
tr.the change from signing to now, its cost: İmzalama anından bugüne kadar olan değişiklik, konuk başına ücretin maliyeti, kilitlenme tarihi ve sayımın zamanında kilitlenip kilitlenmediği
tr.what each use of the reserve paid for, t: Rezervin her kullanımda ne kadar ödendiği, kullanılan pay, her kullanımdan sonra kalan rezerv ve tükenmeden önce uyarı
tr.every change after signing with the reas: nedeni, müşteri onayı ve sahip onay işaretiyle birlikte imzalandıktan sonraki her değişiklik ve değişiklikle birlikte bütçenin kaydedilen her sürümü
tr.fixed and variable cost by guest count b: Konuk aralığına göre sabit ve değişken maliyet, konuk başına maliyet ve tasarruf; 60, 114 veya 250 konuk için doğru teklif verin
tr.hire fee, minimum spend, extra hours and: 100 konuk için kiralama ücreti, minimum harcama, ek saatler ve konuk başına maliyet; yiyecek-içecek harcaması minimuma ulaşmazsa aradaki açık
tr.the price of every vendor service for a: 100 kişilik bir etkinlik için her satıcı hizmetinin fiyatı; fiyatları yakında sona erecek veya zaten dolmuş olacak
tr.the planning fee divided by the hours th: Planlama ücretinin, etkinlik başına ve etkinlik türüne göre ekibin gerçekten çalıştığı saatlere bölünmesiyle elde edilen gelir
tr.spent, committed and still to book give: Harcanmış, taahhüt edilmiş ve hala kayıt yapılmamış Beklenen nihai maliyeti, aşımı, kalan rezervi ve harekete geçmek için zaman varken marjı verin
tr.Event Budget and Costing by Guests: Konuklara göre etkinlik bütçesi ve maliyetlendirme
tr.Planning fee as a share of the budget su: Bütçe ara toplamının payı olarak planlama ücreti
tr.Markup on vendor cost in the client pric: Müşteri fiyatında satıcı maliyetine ilişkin işaretleme
tr.Margin you want on each event before lab: Doğumdan önce her olayda istediğiniz marj
tr.Days ahead to warn of an expiry: Son kullanma tarihi konusunda uyarıda bulunmak için günler kaldı
tr.Days before the event when the guest cou: Konuk sayısının kilitlendiği etkinlikten önceki günler
tr.Food and drink spend per guest for the v: Mekanın minimum tutarı için misafir başına yiyecek ve içecek harcaması
tr.Cost above plan you accept before it cou: Bitmiş sayılmadan önce kabul ettiğiniz planın üzerindeki maliyet
tr.Planning fee per labour hour you want: İstediğiniz çalışma saati başına planlama ücreti
tr.Extra venue hour as a share of the hire: Kira ücretinin bir payı olarak ekstra mekan saati
tr.Budget lines by event and category: Etkinliğe ve kategoriye göre bütçe satırları
tr.One row per event and budget category wi: Bütçe, planlanan, kabul edilen ve fiili maliyetin yer aldığı etkinlik ve bütçe kategorisi başına bir satır; bugüne kadarki maliyet, plandaki sapma, misafir başına maliyet ve bütçe aşımı işareti kendiliğinden doldurulur.
tr.Events with margin, cost per guest and p: Marj, konuk başına maliyet ve plan kontrolü
tr.One row per event with contract value an: Sözleşme değeri ve maliyetlerini içeren etkinlik başına bir satır; marj, misafir başına maliyet, plan kontrolü, kaydedilen saatler, saat başına ücret ve henüz rezervasyon yapılmamış olanlar kendileri tarafından doldurulur.
tr.Share of the budget by event type and ca: Etkinlik türüne ve kategorisine göre bütçenin payı
tr.The usual share of the client budget, th: Geçmiş etkinliklerden alınan, etkinlik türüne göre her kategori için müşteri bütçesinin olağan payı, kar ve misafir başına maliyet; 100 misafirin tutarı doldurulur.
tr.Cost per guest by event type and tier: Etkinlik türüne ve kademeye göre misafir başına maliyet
tr.The low, typical and high cost per guest: Tamamlanan etkinliklerden her etkinlik türü ve kademesi için konuk başına düşük, tipik ve yüksek maliyet; Aralık genişliğini ve 100 misafir için tipik maliyeti doldurun.
tr.Fixed and variable cost by guest count b: Konuk sayısı aralığına göre sabit ve değişken maliyet
tr.Each guest count band with its fixed cos: Her misafir sayma bandı sabit maliyeti ve misafir başına maliyetiyle birlikte; bandın ortasında misafir başına maliyet ve en küçük bant dolumuna karşı tasarruf.
tr.Catering menus with price per guest and: Konuk ve bar başına fiyat içeren yemek menüleri
tr.The menus you offer with the price per g: Misafir başı fiyatı, misafir başına bar ve minimum misafir sayısıyla birlikte sunduğunuz menüler; 100 misafirin toplamı (veya daha yüksekse minimum sayı) doldurulur.
tr.The twelve venues with hire fee, minimum: Kiralama ücreti, minimum harcama, kurulum saatleri ve sokağa çıkma yasağı olan on iki mekan; Minimum harcama kuralı kapsamında 100 misafirin maliyeti ve doldurulan misafir başına maliyet.
tr.Vendor price list with the price for 100: 100 misafirin fiyatını içeren satıcı fiyat listesi
tr.One row per vendor service with the unit: Birim fiyat, minimum ücret ve fiyatın geçerli olduğu süre ile satıcı hizmeti başına bir satır; 100 kişilik bir etkinliğin fiyatı ve geçerlilik kontrolü bilgileri.
tr.Vendor quotes compared by event and cate: Etkinlik ve kategoriye göre satıcı teklifleri
tr.One row per quote received for an event: Seçilen etkinlik ve kategori için alınan teklif başına bir satır; en yüksek ve en iyi teklif, seçilen teklifin kaydedilmesi ve sıralamanın doldurulması.
tr.One row per change of a category budget: İmzadan sonra kategori bütçesindeki değişiklik başına bir satır, nedeni ve müşterinin onaylayıp onaylamadığı; yeni bütçe ve sahip onay bayrağı doldurulur.
tr.Contingency reserve used by event: Etkinlik tarafından kullanılan acil durum yedeği
tr.One row per use of the reserve with what: Ödediği tutarla birlikte rezervin kullanımı başına bir satır; kullanılan rezervin payı, her kullanımdan sonra kalan yedek akçe ve rezervin durumu doldurulur.
tr.One row per event with the guests at sig: İmza sırasında konuklarla, şimdiki konuklarla ve sayımın kilitlendiği günle etkinlik başına bir satır; değişiklik, maliyet etkisi, kilit tarihi ve kilit kontrolü bilgileri doldurulur.
tr.Planning fee share and hours by event ty: Etkinlik türü ve pakete göre ücret payı ve planlama saatleri
tr.The fee share, the smallest fee and the: Her etkinlik türü ve kademesi için ücret paylaşımı, en küçük ücret ve izin verilen saatler; 30.000 bütçedeki ücret ve saat başına ücret doldurulur.
tr.Markup and margin by budget category: Bütçe kategorisine göre işaretleme ve marj
tr.The markup you add on vendor cost in eac: Her kategoride satıcı maliyetine eklediğiniz kâr marjı ve tipik satıcı maliyeti; 10.000 satıcı maliyetinin fiyatı ve marjı doldurulur.
tr.Hours allowed by event type and tier: Etkinlik türüne ve katmana göre izin verilen saatler
tr.The base hours and the hours per guest y: Her etkinlik türü ve katmanı için izin verdiğiniz temel saatler ve misafir başına saat sayısı; 100 misafirin çalışma saatleri ve işçilik maliyeti doldurulur.
tr.Team hours and labour cost by event: Etkinliğe göre ekip saatleri ve işçilik maliyeti
tr.One row per block of hours a team member: Bir ekip üyesinin saatlik maliyeti olan bir etkinlik üzerinde çalıştığı saat bloğu başına bir satır; işçilik maliyeti her etkinliğin saat başına ücretini doldurur ve besler.
tr.Venue and vendor price index by month: Aylara göre mekan ve satıcı fiyat endeksi
tr.One row per month with how much dearer o: Mekanların ve satıcıların ne kadar pahalı veya ucuz olduğu ve talep düzeyi hakkında ayda bir satır; o ayki olaylar ve 10.000 tabanın fiyatı dolduruluyor.
tr.Extras you sell with cost, price and mar: Maliyet, fiyat ve marj ile sattığınız ekstralar
tr.The extras clients ask for with your cos: Müşterilerin sizin maliyetiniz ve fiyatınızla birlikte istediği ekstralar; marj payı dolduğu için istediğiniz marjın altında ekstra satılmaz.
tr.Tasting and sample costs against what th: Müşterinin ödediği tutara karşı tadım maliyetleri
tr.One row per tasting or sample with its c: Maliyeti ve müşteriye fatura edilen tutarla birlikte tadım veya numune başına bir satır; faturalandırılmamış maliyet ve fatura çeki doldurulur.
tr.One row per saved version of an event bu: Etkinlik bütçesinin kayıtlı sürümü başına tarih, toplam ve nedeni içeren bir satır; önceki sürüme göre yapılan değişiklik yerini doldurur.
tr.Average quotes compared per category: Kategori başına karşılaştırıldığında ortalama fiyat teklifleri
tr.Average planning fee per labour hour: Çalışma saati başına ortalama planlama ücreti
tr.Contract value, cost, labour and reserve: Aylara göre sözleşme değeri, maliyet, işçilik ve rezerv
tr.Event budget sheet with every category: Her kategoriyi içeren etkinlik bütçe sayfası
tr.Budget change sheet with the approval ch: Onay kontrolünün yer aldığı bütçe değişiklik sayfası
tr.Budget by category from the guest count: Konuk sayısına göre kategoriye göre bütçe

tr.Read Event Budget Dashboard and Charts e: Her hafta Etkinlik bütçesi kontrol paneli ve Grafikleri okuyun: marj, aşımlar, kullanılan rezerv, misafir sayısı değişiklikleri, çalışma saatleri ve fiyat tekliflerinden tasarruf.
tr.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Bu dosyadaki tüm açılır listeler. Bir öğenin adını burada değiştirin; değişiklik tüm sayfalara yansır.
tr.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Sayfalardaki verilerle otomatik güncellenir. Geçmişe bakmak için yılı değiştirin.
tr.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Sarı hücreden seçim yapın; diğer alanlar otomatik dolar. Yazdırmaya hazır.
tr.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Metni burada düzenleyin; {braces} içindeki ifadeler her satırdaki verilerle doldurulur. Bağlantılar tablolardadır.
tr.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Bir kayıt seçin: her adımın tamamlanma tarihi buna göre belirlenir. Her kayıt için bu sayfanın bir kopyasını oluşturun.
tr.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Sayfalarınızın canlı grafikleri. Sarı hücrelerden seçim yapın; tüm grafikler ve göstergeler kendiliğinden güncellenir.

id.Hello, a budget change of {change} for {: Halo, perubahan anggaran sebesar {change} untuk {event_id} berada di atas {limit} dan memerlukan persetujuan Anda.
id.Hello, the contingency of {event_id} is: Halo, kemungkinan {event_id} telah habis: {used_total} dari {reserve} telah digunakan. Periksa: {state}.
id.Owner: the weekly budget report is ready: Pemilik: laporan anggaran mingguan sudah siap
id.Hello, the weekly budget variance report: Halo, laporan varians anggaran mingguan sudah siap. Centang {name}: dibanjiri {overrun}, margin {margin_share}.
id.Hello, the budget of {event_id} is under: Halo, anggaran {event_id} sedang ditinjau: biaya yang direncanakan {planned_cost}, biaya sekarang {cost_now}. Silakan periksa jalur yang terbuka.
id.Hello, please book the remaining categor: Halo, silakan pesan sisa kategori {event_id}: {unbooked} dari biaya yang direncanakan belum dipesan.
id.Hello, the guest count of {event_id} cha: Halo, jumlah tamu {event_id} diubah menjadi {guests_now}. Harap perbarui pesanan katering.
id.Sample wording, adapt it to your own pra: Contoh kata-katanya, sesuaikan dengan latihan Anda sendiri.
id.Client: {col:events.client}. Event: {col: Klien: {col:events.client}. Acara: tingkat {col:events.name}, {col:events.type}, {col:events.tier}, pada {col:events.date} pukul {col:events.venue}, untuk tamu {col:events.guests_now}.
id.Budget before the planning fee: {col:eve: Anggaran sebelum biaya perencanaan: {col:events.subtotal}. Biaya perencanaan: {col:events.planning_fee}. Nilai kontrak: {col:events.contract_value}. Anggaran berdasarkan kategori ada pada lembar terlampir.
id.The budget includes a reserve for the un: Anggaran tersebut mencakup cadangan untuk hal-hal yang tidak terduga. Perubahan setelah penandatanganan ditulis dan dikirimkan kepada Anda untuk disetujui sebelum ditambahkan.
id.Budget before the change: {col:chg.budge: Anggaran sebelum perubahan: {col:chg.budget_before}. Perubahan: {col:chg.change}. Anggaran baru untuk kategori: {col:chg.new_budget}.
id.Please sign to approve this change. Appr: Harap tanda tangani untuk menyetujui perubahan ini. Disetujui oleh klien: {col:chg.approved}. Perubahan di atas {col:chg.limit} juga memerlukan persetujuan dari pemilik perencana.
id.Contract value {col:events.contract_valu: Nilai kontrak {col:events.contract_value}. Biaya tambahan ditagihkan pada {col:events.extras_billed}. Pendapatan totalnya {col:events.revenue}.
id.Planned vendor cost {col:events.planned_: Biaya vendor yang direncanakan {col:events.planned_cost}, biaya vendor akhir {col:events.cost_now}, yaitu {col:events.cost_pg} per tamu. Setiap kategori tercantum pada lembar terlampir.
id.Contract value {col:events.contract_valu: Nilai kontrak {col:events.contract_value}, yaitu {col:events.value_pg} per tamu. Biaya perencanaan adalah {col:events.planning_fee} dan anggaran sebelum biaya adalah {col:events.subtotal}.
id.If the guest count changes, the price mo: Jika jumlah tamu berubah, harga juga ikut berubah; kami akan mengirimkan gambar baru kepada Anda sebelum kami mengubah pesanan apa pun.
id.This quote: {col:quotes.vendor}, {col:qu: Kutipan ini: {col:quotes.vendor}, {col:quotes.quoted}, diberi peringkat {col:quotes.rank} berdasarkan harga. Kutipan terendah adalah {col:quotes.best_price} dan tertinggi adalah {col:quotes.highest}. Terpilih: {col:quotes.chosen}. Catatan: {col:quotes.notes}.
id.Please confirm which quote you prefer. T: Harap konfirmasi penawaran mana yang Anda sukai. Penyimpanan kutipan yang dipilih terhadap harga tertinggi adalah {col:quotes.saving}.
id.Price per guest {col:menus.price_pg}, ba: Harga per tamu {col:menus.price_pg}, bar per tamu {col:menus.bar_pg}, bersama-sama {col:menus.all_in}. Minimal {col:menus.min_guests} tamu. Untuk 100 tamu totalnya adalah {col:menus.total_100}.
id.Please tell us your food allergy list an: Harap beritahu kami daftar alergi makanan Anda dan persyaratan lainnya setidaknya 21 hari sebelum acara sehingga katering dapat merencanakannya.
id.Venue: {col:venues.name}, {col:venues.ar: Tempat: {col:venues.name}, {col:venues.area}, {col:venues.kind}, kursi {col:venues.seated}. Jam malam {col:venues.curfew}, {col:venues.setup_hours} jam untuk kedatangan dan pengaturan.
id.Hire fee {col:venues.hire_fee}. Minimum: Biaya sewa {col:venues.hire_fee}. Pembelanjaan minimum {col:venues.min_spend}. Jam tambahan {col:venues.extra_hour}. Untuk 100 tamu biayanya adalah {col:venues.cost_100}, yaitu {col:venues.cost_pg} per tamu.
id.The minimum spend counts food and drink: Minimum pembelanjaan hanya menghitung makanan dan minuman saja. Silakan bandingkan tempat ini dengan pilihan lain pada lembar yang sama.
id.Used on {col:cont.date}: {col:cont.used}: Digunakan pada {col:cont.date}: {col:cont.used} untuk {col:cont.what_for}. Digunakan untuk acara sejauh ini: {col:cont.used_total}. Cadangan tersisa setelah penggunaan ini: {col:cont.left_now}. Cek cadangan: {col:cont.state}.
id.Any reserve that is not used is not bill: Cadangan apa pun yang tidak digunakan tidak ditagihkan kepada klien.
id.Revenue {col:events.revenue}. Cost {col:: Pendapatan {col:events.revenue}. Biaya {col:events.cost_now}. Margin sebelum tenaga kerja {col:events.actual_margin}, yaitu {col:events.margin_share}. Pemeriksaan margin: {col:events.target_flag}.
id.Hours logged {col:events.labour_hours},: Jam yang dicatat {col:events.labour_hours}, biaya tenaga kerja {col:events.labour_cost}, biaya perencanaan per jam {col:events.fee_per_hour}. Pemeriksaan rencana: {col:events.plan_flag}.
id.Event {col:gc.event_id}. Guests at signi: Acara {col:gc.event_id}. Tamu saat penandatanganan: {col:gc.guests_signing}. Tamu sekarang: {col:gc.guests_now}, perubahan {col:gc.change}.
id.The cost impact of the change is {col:gc: Dampak biaya dari perubahan ini adalah {col:gc.cost_impact}. Jumlah tamu terkunci pada {col:gc.lock_due}; setelah hari itu kami memesan makanan, minuman dan persewaan untuk nomor yang terkunci.
Harap tanda tangan untuk mengonfirmasi jumlah tamu. Pemeriksaan kunci: {col:gc.lock_state}.
id.Choose the tier and the per-guest budget: Pilih tingkatan dan anggaran per tamu
id.Split the budget with the category share: Bagi anggaran dengan panduan berbagi kategori
id.Ask the owner if above the limit: Tanyakan kepada pemiliknya apakah di atas batas
id.Ask at least three vendors for a quote: Mintalah penawaran dari setidaknya tiga vendor
id.Check what each quote includes: Periksa apa yang termasuk dalam setiap kutipan
id.Show the client the best two: Tunjukkan pada klien dua yang terbaik
id.Send the guest count reminder to the cli: Kirim pengingat jumlah tamu ke klien
id.Update catering, rentals and seating: Perbarui katering, persewaan, dan tempat duduk
id.Send the final cost change to the client: Kirim perubahan biaya akhir ke klien
id.Write down what the reserve paid for: Tuliskan apa yang dibayar oleh cadangan tersebut
id.Check the reserve left for the event: Periksa cadangan yang tersisa untuk acara tersebut
id.Ask the owner if the reserve is used up: Tanyakan kepada pemiliknya apakah cadangannya sudah habis
id.Tell the client what the reserve paid fo: Beritahu klien untuk apa cadangan itu dibayar
id.Match invoices to the agreed cost: Cocokkan faktur dengan biaya yang disepakati
id.Enter the actual cost on every budget li: Masukkan biaya sebenarnya pada setiap baris anggaran
id.Check the overruns and who approved them: Periksa kelebihannya dan siapa yang menyetujuinya
id.Confirm the time with the client and the: Konfirmasikan waktu dengan klien dan vendor
id.Ask the owner to approve a larger overru: Mintalah pemilik untuk menyetujui pengeluaran yang lebih besar
id.Ask each vendor for the new price list: Tanyakan kepada masing-masing vendor daftar harga baru
id.Tell the team what changed: Beri tahu tim apa yang berubah
id.Check the hours and the fee per hour: Periksa jam dan biaya per jam
id.Write what went over and why: Tulis apa yang terjadi dan mengapa
id.Events with a fee yield on target: Acara dengan imbal hasil yang sesuai target
id.Cost per guest per event type: Biaya per tamu per jenis acara
id.Budget moved by changes per month: Anggaran dipindahkan berdasarkan perubahan per bulan
id.Guest count change per event type: Perubahan jumlah tamu per jenis acara
id.Planning fee per hour per event type: Biaya perencanaan per jam per jenis acara
id.Open Start and type your company name an: Buka Mulai dan ketikkan nama perusahaan Anda dan batasan Anda sendiri di sel kuning: pembagian biaya perencanaan, biaya terkecil, markup, margin target, cadangan, dan batas persetujuan pemilik.
id.Check Events: contract value, planned, a: Periksa Acara: nilai kontrak, biaya yang direncanakan, disepakati dan aktual, tamu dan status. Margin, biaya per tamu, dan cek paket terisi sendiri.
id.Enter or check every category on Budget: Masuk atau centang setiap kategori di Garis anggaran. Variansi rencana, biaya per tamu, dan tanda rencana berlebih terisi.
id.Keep Category Share Guide, Per-guest Cos: Selalu perbarui Panduan berbagi kategori, Panduan biaya per tamu, Kelompok jumlah tamu dan Markup berdasarkan kategori: keduanya menjawab berapa biaya yang harus dikeluarkan untuk sebuah acara baru.
id.Use Catering Menus, Venue Pricing, Vendo: Gunakan Menu katering, Penetapan harga tempat, Daftar harga vendor dan Daftar harga tambahan untuk menentukan harga proposal, dan Indeks harga musim untuk melihat pergerakan harga pada bulan tersebut.
id.Record every quote on Quote Comparison a: Catat setiap kutipan pada Perbandingan penawaran dan tandai yang dipilih. Penghematan terhadap kutipan tertinggi dan pengisian peringkat.
id.Record every change after signing on Bud: Catat setiap perubahan setelah masuk pada Perubahan anggaran dan setiap versi yang disimpan pada Versi anggaran. Perubahan di atas batas Anda akan ditandai untuk pemiliknya.
id.Write each use of the reserve on Conting: Tuliskan setiap penggunaan reservasi pada Penggunaan darurat dan setiap perubahan jumlah tamu pada Jumlah tamu berubah. Cadangan tersisa dan cek kunci terisi.
id.Log team hours on Event Hours, keep Labo: Catat jam kerja tim di Jam acara, terus perbarui Tunjangan tenaga kerja dan Jadwal biaya perencanaan dan baca tarif per jam di Acara.
id.Enter every tasting on Tasting Costs: th: Masukkan setiap pencicipan pada Biaya mencicipi: biaya yang tidak Anda tagih ke klien akan ditandai.
id.Use the 14 calculators before you quote:: Gunakan 14 kalkulator sebelum Anda mengutip: anggaran berdasarkan jumlah tamu, katering, tempat, perubahan tamu, markup, harga per tamu, staf, persewaan, bar, pengeluaran berlebih, cadangan, hasil biaya, dua penawaran, dan kisi bagaimana-jika.
id.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Cetak 10 lembar dan 10 dokumen, ikuti 10 daftar periksa dan ketuk tautan pesan untuk membuka obrolan dengan teks yang sudah tertulis (28 pesan).
id.Read Event Budget Dashboard and Charts e: Baca Dasbor anggaran acara dan Bagan setiap minggu: margin, kelebihan, cadangan yang digunakan, perubahan jumlah tamu, jam kerja, dan penghematan dari penawaran harga.
id.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Semua daftar pilihan dalam file ini. Ubah nama item di sini dan semua lembar akan ikut berubah.
id.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Diperbarui otomatis dari lembar kerja Anda. Ubah tahun untuk melihat data sebelumnya.
id.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Pilih di sel kuning; sel lainnya terisi otomatis. Siap dicetak.
id.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Ubah redaksinya di sini; teks dalam tanda kurung kurawal akan diisi dari setiap baris. Tautannya ada di tabel.
id.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Pilih catatan: setiap langkah akan memiliki tanggal jatuh tempo. Salin lembar ini untuk setiap catatan.
id.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Grafik yang diperbarui otomatis dari lembar kerja Anda. Pilih di sel kuning dan semua grafik serta indikator akan diperbarui otomatis.

fr.Know what an event will cost and earn be: Sachez combien coûtera un événement et gagnez avant le jour
fr.Event budgets by guest count, quotes, re: Budgets par nombre d'invités, devis, réserve et marge pour organisateurs
fr.Budget by guest count and tier: Budget par nombre d'invités et niveau
fr.type the guests and the budget per guest: saisissez invités et budget par invité; chaque catégorie reçoit son montant selon vos parts, avec frais de planification et valeur du contrat
fr.every event and category shows budget, p: chaque événement et catégorie affiche le budget, le coût prévu, convenu et réel avec l'écart, le coût par invité et un indicateur de dépassement du plan
fr.Event margin and cost per guest: Marge de l'événement et coût par invité
fr.planned and actual margin, margin share,: marge prévue et réelle, part de marge, coût par invité et frais par heure de travail pour chaque événement, avec alerte si la marge est sous votre cible
fr.every quote for a category side by side: chaque devis d'une catégorie côte à côte avec le plus haut, le plus bas, le rang et la sauvegarde du devis que vous avez choisi
fr.Guest count change and lock date: Changement d'invités et date de blocage
fr.the change from signing to now, its cost: le changement depuis la signature jusqu'à maintenant, son coût pour le prix par invité, la date de verrouillage et si le compte est verrouillé à temps
fr.what each use of the reserve paid for, t: ce que chaque utilisation de la réserve a payé, la part utilisée, la réserve laissée après chaque utilisation et un avertissement avant son épuisement
fr.every change after signing with the reas: chaque changement après signature, avec motif, accord du client et validation du propriétaire, et chaque version enregistrée du budget avec sa modification
fr.fixed and variable cost by guest count b: coûts fixes et variables par tranche montrent le coût par invité et l'économie face à la plus petite tranche, pour chiffrer juste à 60, 114 ou 250 invités
fr.Venue pricing with the minimum spend rul: Tarifs du lieu avec règle du minimum de dépenses
fr.hire fee, minimum spend, extra hours and: frais de location, minimum, heures supplémentaires et coût par invité pour 100 invités, avec le manque si la dépense boisson-nourriture reste sous le minimum
fr.Vendor price list with a validity check: Tarifs fournisseur avec contrôle de validité
fr.the price of every vendor service for a: le prix de chaque service fournisseur pour un événement de 100 invités, avec des prix qui expirent bientôt ou ont déjà expiré
fr.Fee yield per labour hour: Rendement des frais par heure travaillée
fr.the planning fee divided by the hours th: les frais de planification divisés par les heures réellement travaillées par l'équipe, par événement et par type d'événement, par rapport au rendement souhaité
fr.Overrun forecast before the day: Anticipez les dépassements avant le jour J
fr.spent, committed and still to book give: dépensé, engagé et encore à comptabiliser donner le coût final attendu, le dépassement, la réserve restante et la marge pendant qu'il est temps d'agir
fr.Event Budget and Costing by Guests: Budget événementiel et coût par invité
fr.Planning fee as a share of the budget su: Frais de planification en pourcentage du sous-total du budget
fr.Smallest planning fee: Frais de planification les plus bas
fr.Markup on vendor cost in the client pric: Majoration sur le coût du fournisseur dans le prix client
fr.Margin you want on each event before lab: Marge souhaitée sur chaque événement avant travail
fr.Share of the reserve used that raises a: Part de la réserve utilisée qui donne lieu à un avertissement
fr.Days ahead to warn of an expiry: Jours à venir pour avertir d'une expiration
fr.Days before the event when the guest cou: Jours avant l'événement lorsque le décompte des invités se verrouille
fr.Budget change that needs the owner to ap: Modification du budget qui nécessite l'approbation du propriétaire
fr.Food and drink spend per guest for the v: Dépenses minimales en nourriture et en boissons par invité pour le lieu
fr.Weight of the venue price in the season: Poids du prix du lieu dans l'indice de saison
fr.Cost above plan you accept before it cou: Plan à coût supérieur que vous acceptez avant qu'il ne soit considéré comme terminé
fr.Planning fee per labour hour you want: Frais de planification par heure de travail souhaitée
fr.Extra venue hour as a share of the hire: Heure supplémentaire sur place en tant que part des frais de location
fr.Client upgraded an item: Le client a pris un extra
fr.Venue 1 is cheapest: Le lieu 1 est le moins cher
fr.Venue 2 is cheapest: Le lieu 2 est le moins cher
fr.Venue 3 is cheapest: Le lieu 3 est le moins cher
fr.Budget lines by event and category: Lignes budgétaires par événement et catégorie
fr.One row per event and budget category wi: Une ligne par événement et catégorie budgétaire avec le budget, les coûts prévus, convenus et réels ; le coût à ce jour, l'écart par rapport au plan, le coût par invité et l'indicateur de dépassement de budget se remplissent d'eux-mêmes.
fr.Cost to date or forecast: Coût à ce jour ou prévu
fr.Events with margin, cost per guest and p: Événements: marge, coût par invité, contrôle du plan
fr.One row per event with contract value an: Une ligne par événement avec la valeur du contrat et les coûts ; la marge, le coût par invité, le chèque de forfait, les heures enregistrées, le tarif horaire et ce qui n'est pas encore réservé se remplissent d'eux-mêmes.
fr.Share of the budget by event type and ca: Part du budget par type et catégorie d'événement
fr.The usual share of the client budget, th: La part habituelle du budget client, la majoration et le coût par invité pour chaque catégorie par type d'événement, tirés des événements passés ; le montant pour 100 invités est complété.
fr.Cost per guest by event type and tier: Coût par invité par type d'événement et niveau
fr.The low, typical and high cost per guest: Le coût par invité faible, typique et élevé pour chaque type et niveau d'événement, à partir des événements terminés ; la largeur de la gamme et le coût typique pour 100 invités sont indiqués.
fr.Fixed and variable cost by guest count b: Coût fixe et variable par tranche de nombre d'invités
fr.Each guest count band with its fixed cos: Chaque invité compte le groupe avec son coût fixe et son coût par invité ; le coût par invité au milieu du groupe et l'économie sur le plus petit groupe sont complétés.
fr.Saving against the smallest band: Économiser sur la plus petite bande
fr.Catering menus with price per guest and: Menus traiteur avec prix par convive et bar
fr.The menus you offer with the price per g: Les menus que vous proposez avec le prix par convive, le bar par convive et le minimum de convives ; le total pour 100 invités (ou le minimum, s'il est supérieur) est rempli.
fr.The twelve venues with hire fee, minimum: Les douze salles avec frais de location, dépenses minimales, heures d'installation et couvre-feu ; indiquez le coût pour 100 invités selon la règle de dépense minimale et le coût par invité.
fr.Minimum spend not reached at 100 guests: Dépense minimale non atteinte à 100 invités
fr.Vendor price list with the price for 100: Liste de prix du fournisseur avec le prix pour 100 invités
fr.One row per vendor service with the unit: Une ligne par service fournisseur avec le prix unitaire, les frais minimum et la durée de validité du prix ; le prix pour un événement de 100 invités et le contrôle de validité sont à remplir.
fr.Price for a 100-guest event: Prix pour un événement de 100 invités
fr.Vendor quotes compared by event and cate: Devis fournisseurs comparés par événement et catégorie
fr.One row per quote received for an event: Une ligne par devis reçu pour un événement et une catégorie, avec celui choisi ; la cotation la plus élevée et la meilleure, la sauvegarde de la cotation choisie et le classement à renseigner.
fr.Budget changes with client approval: Modifications du budget avec l'approbation du client
fr.One row per change of a category budget: Une ligne par changement de catégorie de budget après signature, avec le motif et si le client a approuvé ; le nouveau budget et le drapeau d'approbation du propriétaire sont remplis.
fr.Contingency reserve used by event: Réserve pour imprévus utilisée par événement
fr.One row per use of the reserve with what: Une ligne par utilisation de la réserve avec ce qu'elle a payé ; la part de la réserve utilisée, la réserve laissée après chaque utilisation et l'état de la réserve à renseigner.
fr.Left counted once: La gauche a compté une fois
fr.Guest count at signing against now: Nombre d'invités lors de la signature maintenant
fr.One row per event with the guests at sig: Une rangée par événement avec les invités à la signature, les invités maintenant et le jour où le décompte a été verrouillé ; le changement, l'impact financier, la date de verrouillage et le contrôle de verrouillage sont complétés.
fr.Planning fee share and hours by event ty: Part des frais et heures par type d'événement et niveau
fr.The fee share, the smallest fee and the: La part des frais, les frais les plus bas et les heures autorisées pour chaque type et niveau d'événement ; le tarif sur un budget de 30 000 et le tarif horaire à compléter.
fr.Markup and margin by budget category: Majoration et marge par catégorie budgétaire
fr.The markup you add on vendor cost in eac: La majoration que vous ajoutez au coût du fournisseur dans chaque catégorie et un coût typique du fournisseur ; le prix et la marge sur un coût fournisseur de 10 000 sont indiqués.
fr.Hours allowed by event type and tier: Heures autorisées par type d'événement et niveau
fr.The base hours and the hours per guest y: Les heures de base et les heures par invité que vous autorisez pour chaque type et niveau d'événement ; les heures pour 100 invités et le coût de la main d'œuvre sont complétés.
fr.Labour cost for 100 guests: Coût de la main d'œuvre pour 100 invités
fr.Team hours and labour cost by event: Heures d'équipe et coût de la main d'œuvre par événement
fr.One row per block of hours a team member: Une ligne par bloc d'heures pendant lesquelles un membre de l'équipe a travaillé sur un événement avec le coût horaire ; le coût de la main d'œuvre complète et alimente le tarif horaire de chaque événement.
fr.Venue and vendor price index by month: Indice des prix des lieux et des fournisseurs par mois
fr.One row per month with how much dearer o: Une ligne par mois indiquant combien les lieux et les vendeurs sont plus chers ou moins chers et le niveau de la demande ; les événements de ce mois-là et le prix d'une base de 10 000 sont complétés.
fr.Extras you sell with cost, price and mar: Extras que vous vendez avec coût, prix et marge
fr.The extras clients ask for with your cos: Les extras que les clients demandent avec votre coût et votre prix ; la part de marge se remplit donc aucun extra n'est vendu en dessous de la marge souhaitée.
fr.Tasting and sample costs against what th: Coûts de dégustation face à ce que paie le client
fr.One row per tasting or sample with its c: Une ligne par dégustation ou échantillon avec son coût et le montant facturé au client ; le coût non facturé et le chèque de facturation à compléter.
fr.Budget versions with the change from the: Versions du budget avec l'écart par rapport à la précédente
fr.One row per saved version of an event bu: Une ligne par version enregistrée d'un budget d'événement avec la date, le total et le motif ; le changement par rapport à la version précédente est complété.
fr.Change from the previous version: Changement par rapport à la version précédente
fr.Events over their cost plan: Événements sur leur plan de coûts
fr.Average margin share of completed events: Part de marge moyenne des événements réalisés
fr.Average contract value per guest: Valeur moyenne du contrat par invité
fr.Planned cost of upcoming events: Coût prévu des événements à venir
fr.Agreed cost of upcoming events: Coût convenu des événements à venir
fr.Share of upcoming budget not yet booked: Part du budget à venir non encore réservée
fr.Average variance of cost to plan: Écart moyen du coût par rapport au plan
fr.Largest overrun on one event: Plus grand dépassement sur un événement

de.Please tell us your food allergy list an: Bitte teilen Sie uns Ihre Lebensmittelallergieliste und eventuelle weitere Anforderungen spätestens 21 Tage vor der Veranstaltung mit, damit der Caterer planen kann.

de.The minimum spend counts food and drink: Der Mindestumsatz gilt nur für Speisen und Getränke. Bitte vergleichen Sie diesen Veranstaltungsort mit den anderen Optionen auf demselben Blatt.

de.Any reserve that is not used is not bill: Eine nicht genutzte Reserve wird dem Kunden nicht in Rechnung gestellt.

de.The cost impact of the change is {col:gc: Die Kostenauswirkungen der Änderung betragen {col:gc.cost_impact}. Die Anzahl der Gäste wird auf {col:gc.lock_due} festgelegt. Nach diesem Tag bestellen wir Essen, Getränke und Verleih für die gesperrte Nummer.
Bitte unterschreiben Sie, um die Gästezahl zu bestätigen. Sperrprüfung: {col:gc.lock_state}.
de.Confirm the guest count and the date: Bestätigen Sie die Gästezahl und das Datum
de.Choose the tier and the per-guest budget: Wählen Sie die Stufe und das Budget pro Gast
de.Split the budget with the category share: Teilen Sie das Budget mit dem Leitfaden zur Kategoriefreigabe auf
de.Check the venue minimum spend: Überprüfen Sie die Mindestausgaben für den Veranstaltungsort
de.Ask vendors for quotes: Bitten Sie die Anbieter um Angebote
de.Add the planning fee and the reserve: Fügen Sie die Planungsgebühr und die Reserve hinzu
de.Send the budget to the client: Senden Sie das Budget an den Kunden
de.Write the change and the reason: Schreiben Sie die Änderung und den Grund auf
de.Ask the owner if above the limit: Fragen Sie den Eigentümer, wenn der Grenzwert überschritten wird
de.Send the change to the client: Senden Sie die Änderung an den Kunden
de.Record the client approval: Notieren Sie die Zustimmung des Kunden
de.Update the budget lines and the version: Aktualisieren Sie die Budgetzeilen und die Version
de.Ask at least three vendors for a quote: Bitten Sie mindestens drei Anbieter um ein Angebot
de.Check what each quote includes: Überprüfen Sie, was jedes Angebot beinhaltet
de.Add travel, set-up and overtime: Fügen Sie Reise-, Einrichtungs- und Überstunden hinzu
de.Show the client the best two: Zeigen Sie dem Kunden die besten zwei
de.Thank the other vendors: Bedanken Sie sich bei den anderen Anbietern
de.Send the guest count reminder to the cli: Senden Sie die Erinnerung an die Gästezahl an den Kunden
de.Lock the count on the lock date: Sperren Sie die Zählung am Sperrdatum
de.Update catering, rentals and seating: Aktualisieren Sie Catering, Vermietung und Sitzplätze
de.Tell the venue the final number: Teilen Sie dem Veranstaltungsort die endgültige Nummer mit
de.Send the final cost change to the client: Senden Sie die endgültige Kostenänderung an den Kunden
de.Write down what the reserve paid for: Schreiben Sie auf, wofür die Reserve bezahlt wurde
de.Check the reserve left for the event: Überprüfen Sie die für die Veranstaltung verbleibende Reserve
de.Tell the lead the reserve left: Sagen Sie dem Anführer, dass die Reserve gegangen ist
de.Ask the owner if the reserve is used up: Fragen Sie den Eigentümer, ob die Reserve aufgebraucht ist
de.Add the use to the final cost: Addieren Sie die Nutzung zu den Endkosten
de.Tell the client what the reserve paid fo: Teilen Sie dem Kunden mit, wofür die Reserve bezahlt wurde
de.Match invoices to the agreed cost: Ordnen Sie Rechnungen den vereinbarten Kosten zu
de.Enter the actual cost on every budget li: Geben Sie die tatsächlichen Kosten für jede Budgetzeile ein
de.Check the overruns and who approved them: Überprüfen Sie die Überschreitungen und wer sie genehmigt hat
de.Bill extras that the client approved: Rechnungszusätze, die der Kunde genehmigt hat
de.Confirm the time with the client and the: Bestätigen Sie den Zeitpunkt mit dem Kunden und dem Anbieter
de.Attend the tasting: Nehmen Sie an der Verkostung teil
de.Bill the tasting if it is billable: Rechnen Sie die Verkostung ab, wenn sie kostenpflichtig ist
de.Find the categories over plan: Finden Sie die Kategorien im Plan
de.Check what the vendor changed: Überprüfen Sie, was der Anbieter geändert hat
de.Offer the client two options: Bieten Sie dem Kunden zwei Möglichkeiten
de.Ask the owner to approve a larger overru: Bitten Sie den Eigentümer, eine größere Überschreitung zu genehmigen
de.List the prices that expire: Listen Sie die Preise auf, die ablaufen
de.Ask each vendor for the new price list: Fragen Sie jeden Anbieter nach der neuen Preisliste
de.Enter the new prices and dates: Geben Sie die neuen Preise und Termine ein
de.Compare with the old prices: Vergleichen Sie mit den alten Preisen
de.Update the markup and the extras list: Aktualisieren Sie das Markup und die Extras-Liste
de.Tell the team what changed: Sagen Sie dem Team, was sich geändert hat
de.Check the final cost against the plan: Überprüfen Sie die endgültigen Kosten anhand des Plans
de.Check the margin against the target: Überprüfen Sie den Spielraum anhand des Ziels
de.Check the hours and the fee per hour: Überprüfen Sie die Stunden und die Gebühr pro Stunde
de.Write what went over and why: Schreiben Sie, was passiert ist und warum
de.Update the category share guide: Aktualisieren Sie den Leitfaden zum Teilen von Kategorien
de.Agree one change with the team: Vereinbaren Sie eine Änderung mit dem Team
de.Events with a fee yield on target: Veranstaltungen mit einer Gage-Rendite im Plan
de.Budget against cost per category: Budget im Vergleich zu Kosten pro Kategorie
de.Budget moved by changes per month: Budget wird durch Änderungen pro Monat verschoben
de.Open Start and type your company name an: Öffnen Sie Start und geben Sie Ihren Firmennamen und Ihre eigenen Grenzen in die gelben Zellen ein: den Planungsgebührenanteil, die kleinste Gebühr, den Aufschlag, die Zielmarge, die Reserve und das Eigentümergenehmigungslimit.
de.Check Events: contract value, planned, a: Überprüfen Sie Ereignisse: Vertragswert, geplante, vereinbarte und tatsächliche Kosten, Gäste und Status. Die Marge, die Kosten pro Gast und der Plancheck ergänzen sich von selbst.
de.Enter or check every category on Budget: Geben Sie jede Kategorie auf Haushaltslinien ein oder überprüfen Sie sie. Geben Sie die Planabweichung, die Kosten pro Gast und die Markierung „Überplan“ ein.
de.Keep Category Share Guide, Per-guest Cos: Halten Sie Leitfaden zum Teilen in der Kategorie, Kostenführer pro Gast, Gäste zählen Bands und Markup nach Kategorie aktuell: Sie geben Auskunft darüber, wie viel eine neue Veranstaltung kosten sollte.
de.Use Catering Menus, Venue Pricing, Vendo: Verwenden Sie Catering-Menüs, Preise für Veranstaltungsorte, Preisliste des Anbieters und Preisliste für Extras, um den Preis für ein Angebot anzugeben, und Saisonpreisindex, um zu sehen, wie sich der Monat auf den Preis auswirkt.
de.Record every quote on Quote Comparison a: Notieren Sie jedes Zitat auf Angebotsvergleich und markieren Sie das ausgewählte. Die Ersparnis gegenüber dem höchsten Angebot und dem Rang wird ausgefüllt.
de.Record every change after signing on Bud: Notieren Sie jede Änderung nach der Anmeldung am Budgetänderungen und jede gespeicherte Version am Budgetversionen. Änderungen, die über Ihrem Limit liegen, werden für den Eigentümer gekennzeichnet.
de.Write each use of the reserve on Conting: Schreiben Sie jede Nutzung des Reservats auf Notfalleinsatz und jede Änderung der Gästezahl auf Änderungen der Gästezahl. Die Reserve ist übrig und der Sperrcheck wird ausgefüllt.
de.Log team hours on Event Hours, keep Labo: Protokollieren Sie die Teamstunden auf Veranstaltungszeiten, halten Sie Arbeitszulage und Gebührenordnung für die Planung auf dem neuesten Stand und lesen Sie die Gebühr pro Stunde für Veranstaltungen ab.
de.Enter every tasting on Tasting Costs: th: Geben Sie jede Verkostung am Verkostungskosten ein: Die Kosten, die Sie dem Kunden nicht in Rechnung gestellt haben, werden markiert.
de.Use the 14 calculators before you quote:: Nutzen Sie die 14 Rechner, bevor Sie ein Angebot abgeben: Budget nach Gästezahl, Catering, Veranstaltungsorten, Gästewechsel, Aufschlag, Preis pro Gast, Personal, Mieten, Bar, Überschreitung, Reserve, Honorarertrag, zwei Angebote und ein Was-wäre-wenn-Raster.
de.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Dokumente aus, befolgen Sie 10 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Chat mit dem bereits geschriebenen Text zu öffnen (28 Nachrichten).
de.Read Event Budget Dashboard and Charts e: Lesen Sie jede Woche Dashboard für das Veranstaltungsbudget und Diagramme: Marge, Überschreitungen, genutzte Reserve, Änderungen der Gästezahl, Arbeitsstunden und Einsparungen durch Angebote.
de.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle Auswahllisten dieser Datei. Ändere hier einen Eintrag, und er wird in allen Tabellen übernommen.
de.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wird anhand deiner Tabellen aktualisiert. Ändere das Jahr, um frühere Daten anzusehen.
de.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Wähle die gelbe Zelle aus; der Rest wird automatisch ausgefüllt. Druckbereit.
de.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Bearbeite den Text hier; Wörter in {Klammern} werden aus jeder Zeile übernommen. Die Verknüpfungen findest du in den Tabellen.
de.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Wähle einen Eintrag aus: Für jeden Schritt wird das Fälligkeitsdatum berechnet. Erstelle für jeden Eintrag eine Kopie dieses Tabellenblatts.
de.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Aktuelle Diagramme deiner Tabellen. Wähle die gelben Zellen aus, und alle Diagramme und Messanzeigen werden automatisch aktualisiert.

it.Know what an event will cost and earn be: Scopri quanto costerà un evento e guadagna prima del giorno

it.every event and category shows budget, p: ogni evento e categoria mostra il budget, il costo pianificato, concordato ed effettivo con lo scostamento, il costo per ospite e un flag fuori programma
it.Event margin and cost per guest: Margine evento e costo per ospite
it.planned and actual margin, margin share,: margine previsto ed effettivo, quota, costo per ospite e compenso per ora per ogni evento, con segnalazione sotto il margine obiettivo

it.fixed and variable cost by guest count b: costi fissi e variabili per fascia mostrano il costo per ospite e il risparmio sulla fascia minore, così preventiva giusto per 60, 114 o 250 ospiti

it.Fee yield per labour hour: Resa del compenso per ora di lavoro
it.the planning fee divided by the hours th: la tariffa di pianificazione divisa per le ore effettivamente lavorate dal team, per evento e per tipo di evento, rispetto al rendimento desiderato
it.Overrun forecast before the day: Previsione di sforamento prima del giorno
it.spent, committed and still to book give: speso, impegnato e ancora da contabilizzare, fornire il costo finale previsto, lo sconfinamento, la riserva rimasta e il margine mentre c'è tempo per agire
it.Event Budget and Costing by Guests: Budget evento e costi per ospite
it.Planning fee as a share of the budget su: Commissione di pianificazione come quota del totale parziale del budget
it.Markup on vendor cost in the client pric: Markup sul costo del fornitore nel prezzo del cliente
it.Margin you want on each event before lab: Margine che desideri su ogni evento prima del travaglio
it.Share of the reserve used that raises a: Quota della riserva utilizzata che solleva un avvertimento
it.Days ahead to warn of an expiry: Giorni prima di avvisare di una scadenza
it.Days before the event when the guest cou: Giorni prima dell'evento in cui il conteggio degli invitati si blocca
it.Budget change that needs the owner to ap: Modifica del budget che richiede l'approvazione del proprietario
it.Food and drink spend per guest for the v: Spesa minima per cibo e bevande per ospite nella sede

it.Extra venue hour as a share of the hire: Ora extra della sede come quota del canone di noleggio

it.Venue 3 is cheapest: Il luogo 3 è il più economico

it.One row per event and budget category wi: Una riga per evento e categoria di budget con il budget, il costo pianificato, concordato ed effettivo; il costo fino ad oggi, la varianza da pianificare, il costo per ospite e il contrassegno di superamento del budget si compilano da soli.
it.Cost to date or forecast: Costo fino ad oggi o previsione
it.Events with margin, cost per guest and p: Eventi con margine, costo per ospite e verifica del piano
it.One row per event with contract value an: Una riga per evento con valore e costi del contratto; il margine, il costo per ospite, il controllo del piano, le ore registrate, la tariffa oraria e ciò che non è ancora prenotato compilano da soli.
it.Guest count locks on: Il conteggio degli ospiti è bloccato
it.Share of the budget by event type and ca: Ripartizione del budget per tipo di evento e categoria
it.The usual share of the client budget, th: La quota abituale del budget del cliente, il ricarico e il costo per ospite per ciascuna categoria per tipo di evento, tratto da eventi passati; viene compilato l'importo per 100 ospiti.
it.Cost per guest by event type and tier: Costo per ospite per tipo di evento e livello
it.The low, typical and high cost per guest: Il costo basso, tipico e alto per ospite per ogni tipo di evento e livello, dagli eventi completati; inserire l'ampiezza dell'intervallo e il costo tipico per 100 ospiti.
it.Fixed and variable cost by guest count b: Costo fisso e variabile per fascia di numero di ospiti
it.Each guest count band with its fixed cos: Ogni fascia di conteggio degli ospiti con il suo costo fisso e il suo costo per ospite; si inserisce il costo per ospite a metà della fascia ed il risparmio sulla fascia più piccola.
it.Saving against the smallest band: Risparmiare contro la fascia più piccola
it.Catering menus with price per guest and: Menù ristorazione con prezzo per ospite e bar
it.The menus you offer with the price per g: I menu che offri con il prezzo per ospite, il bar per ospite e gli ospiti minimi; viene compilato il totale per 100 ospiti (o il minimo, se superiore).
it.The twelve venues with hire fee, minimum: Le dodici sedi con canone di locazione, spesa minima, orari di allestimento e coprifuoco; compilare il costo per 100 ospiti in base alla regola di spesa minima e il costo per ospite.
it.Minimum spend not reached at 100 guests: Spesa minima non raggiunta a 100 ospiti
it.Vendor price list with the price for 100: Listino prezzi dei venditori con il prezzo per 100 ospiti
it.One row per vendor service with the unit: Una riga per servizio del fornitore con il prezzo unitario, la tariffa minima e la durata di validità del prezzo; compilare il prezzo per un evento da 100 invitati e il controllo di validità.
it.Price for a 100-guest event: Prezzo per un evento da 100 ospiti
it.Vendor quotes compared by event and cate: Preventivi dei venditori confrontati per evento e categoria
it.One row per quote received for an event: Una riga per preventivo ricevuto per evento e categoria, con quello prescelto; la quotazione più alta e migliore, il salvataggio della quotazione scelta e la compilazione della classifica.
it.Budget changes with client approval: Variazioni di budget con l'approvazione del cliente
it.One row per change of a category budget: Una riga per modifica del budget di una categoria dopo la firma, con il motivo e se il cliente ha approvato; vengono compilati il nuovo budget e il contrassegno di approvazione del proprietario.
it.One row per use of the reserve with what: Una riga per utilizzo della riserva con quanto pagato; compilare la quota della riserva utilizzata, la riserva rimasta dopo ogni utilizzo e lo stato della riserva.
it.Reserve counted once: La riserva è stata conteggiata una volta
it.Left counted once: La sinistra ha contato una volta
it.Guest count at signing against now: Gli ospiti contano al momento della firma contro adesso
it.One row per event with the guests at sig: Una riga per evento con gli ospiti alla firma, gli ospiti presenti e il giorno in cui il conteggio è stato bloccato; la modifica, l'impatto sui costi, la data di blocco e la compilazione del controllo del blocco.
it.Planning fee share and hours by event ty: Quota compenso e ore per tipo di evento e fascia
it.The fee share, the smallest fee and the: La quota di compenso, la tariffa minima e le ore consentite per ciascun tipo di evento e livello; compilare la tariffa su un budget di 30.000 e la tariffa oraria.
it.Markup and margin by budget category: Markup e margine per categoria di budget
it.The markup you add on vendor cost in eac: Il ricarico aggiunto al costo del fornitore in ciascuna categoria e un costo del fornitore tipico; compilare il prezzo e il margine su un costo fornitore di 10.000.
it.Margin on 10,000 vendor cost: Margine sul costo del fornitore di 10.000
it.Hours allowed by event type and tier: Ore consentite per tipo di evento e livello
it.The base hours and the hours per guest y: Le ore base e le ore per ospite consentite per ogni tipo di evento e livello; compilare le ore per 100 ospiti e il costo della manodopera.
it.Team hours and labour cost by event: Ore del team e costo della manodopera per evento
it.One row per block of hours a team member: Una riga per blocco di ore in cui un membro del team ha lavorato a un evento con il costo orario; il costo della manodopera integra e alimenta la tariffa oraria di ciascun evento.
it.Venue and vendor price index by month: Sede e indice dei prezzi dei venditori per mese
it.One row per month with how much dearer o: Una riga al mese con quanto sono più cari o meno costosi i luoghi e i venditori e il livello della domanda; vengono compilati gli eventi di quel mese e il prezzo di una base di 10.000.
it.Extras you sell with cost, price and mar: Extra che vendi con costo, prezzo e margine
it.The extras clients ask for with your cos: Gli extra che i clienti richiedono con il tuo costo e il tuo prezzo; la quota di margine si riempie in modo che nessun extra venga venduto al di sotto del margine desiderato.
it.Tasting and sample costs against what th: Costi di degustazione rispetto a quanto paga il cliente
it.One row per tasting or sample with its c: Una riga per degustazione o campione con il relativo costo e l'importo fatturato al cliente; compilare il costo non fatturato e il controllo della fatturazione.
it.Budget versions with the change from the: Versioni economiche con la modifica rispetto all'ultima
it.One row per saved version of an event bu: Una riga per versione salvata del budget di un evento con la data, il totale e il motivo; si integra la modifica rispetto alla versione precedente.
it.Budget lines over their plan: Linee di budget sul loro piano
it.Events over their cost plan: Eventi oltre il loro piano di costi
it.Average margin share of completed events: Quota di margine media degli eventi completati
it.Average contract value per guest: Valore medio del contratto per ospite
it.Share of upcoming budget not yet booked: Quota del prossimo budget non ancora prenotata
it.Average variance of cost to plan: Variazione media del costo da pianificare
it.Largest overrun on one event: Il superamento più grande di un evento
it.Average guest count change: Variazione media del conteggio degli ospiti
it.Events with a head count change: Eventi con una modifica del conteggio degli ospiti
it.Extras billed against overruns: Extra fatturati in caso di superamento
it.Unbilled tasting and sample costs: Costi di degustazione e campione non fatturati
it.Labour hours in the last 30 days: Ore di lavoro negli ultimi 30 giorni
it.Labour cost in the last 30 days: Costo della manodopera negli ultimi 30 giorni
it.Average planning fee per labour hour: Tariffa media di pianificazione per ora di lavoro

it.Open Start and type your company name an: Apri Start e digita il nome della tua azienda e i tuoi limiti nelle celle gialle: la quota della commissione di pianificazione, la commissione più piccola, il ricarico, il margine target, la riserva e il limite di approvazione del proprietario.
it.Check Events: contract value, planned, a: Controlla eventi: valore del contratto, costo pianificato, concordato ed effettivo, ospiti e stato. Il margine, il costo per ospite e il controllo del piano si compilano da soli.
it.Enter or check every category on Budget: Inserisci o controlla ogni categoria su Linee di bilancio. Compilare la varianza da pianificare, il costo per ospite e il flag di superamento del piano.
it.Keep Category Share Guide, Per-guest Cos: Mantieni aggiornati Guida alla condivisione delle categorie, Guida ai costi per ospite, Fasce conteggio ospiti e Markup per categoria: rispondono a quanto dovrebbe costare un nuovo evento.
it.Use Catering Menus, Venue Pricing, Vendo: Utilizza Menù ristorazione, Prezzi della sede, Listino prezzi del venditore e Listino prezzi extra per valutare una proposta e Indice dei prezzi stagionali per vedere come il mese sposta il prezzo.
it.Record every quote on Quote Comparison a: Registra ogni citazione su Confronto preventivi e segna quella scelta. Il risparmio rispetto alla quotazione più alta e il posizionamento vengono compilati.
it.Record every change after signing on Bud: Registra ogni modifica dopo aver effettuato l'accesso su Cambiamenti di bilancio e ogni versione salvata su Versioni economiche. Le modifiche superiori al limite vengono contrassegnate per il proprietario.
it.Write each use of the reserve on Conting: Scrivi ogni utilizzo della riserva su Uso contingente e ogni cambio del conteggio degli ospiti su Il conteggio degli ospiti cambia. La riserva rimasta e il controllo della serratura vengono compilati.
it.Log team hours on Event Hours, keep Labo: Registra le ore del team su Orari dell'evento, mantieni aggiornati Indennità di lavoro e Piano tariffario di pianificazione e leggi la tariffa oraria su Eventi.
it.Enter every tasting on Tasting Costs: th: Inserisci ogni degustazione il giorno Costi di degustazione: vengono contrassegnati i costi che non hai fatturato al cliente.
it.Use the 14 calculators before you quote:: Utilizza i 14 calcolatori prima di fare un preventivo: budget per numero di ospiti, catering, sedi, cambi di ospiti, ricarico, prezzo per ospite, personale, affitti, bar, superamento, riserva, rendimento delle commissioni, due preventivi e una griglia ipotetica.
it.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Stampa 10 fogli e 10 documenti, segui 10 liste di controllo e tocca il collegamento di un messaggio per aprire una chat con il testo già scritto (28 messaggi).
it.Read Event Budget Dashboard and Charts e: Leggi Dashboard del budget dell'evento e grafici ogni settimana: margine, superamenti, riserva utilizzata, modifiche al conteggio degli ospiti, ore di manodopera e risparmi derivanti dai preventivi.
it.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Tutti gli elenchi a discesa del file. Modifica qui una voce e si aggiornerà in tutti i fogli.
it.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Si aggiorna dai tuoi fogli. Cambia l’anno per consultare i dati passati.
it.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Scegli nella cella gialla; il resto si compila da sé. Il modulo è pronto da stampare.
it.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Modifica qui il testo; le parole tra {braces} vengono compilate usando i dati di ogni riga. I collegamenti si trovano nelle tabelle.
it.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Scegli una voce: ogni passaggio avrà la propria data di scadenza. Crea una copia di questo foglio per ogni voce.
it.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Grafici aggiornati dai tuoi fogli. Scegli nelle celle gialle e tutti i grafici e gli indicatori si aggiorneranno.
it.The numbers behind the charts: I dati alla base dei grafici
